To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a PLE is a collection of tools and services that are used to support a person's learning process, and that the mobile learner is in control of shaping his mobile learning environment.

a symbiotic interrelated seamless integrated mobile personalizable learning environment is a mobile learning environment where the learner is in control of shaping his own learning environment seamlessly.
the 2SIMPLE approach allows the user to create a symbiotic interrelated and seamlessly integrated mobile PLE.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the question how to design a mobile personaliza- ble learning environment that allows the user to create a mobile learning environment that fits his personal needs and is able to use it in a seamless manner.

the design of symbiotic interrelated seamless integrated mobile personalizable learning en- vironments (2SIMPLE) where the user is able to create his own learning environment and to use it in a seamless way.
the development of a concept for seamless inter- relation of mobile applications in a symbiotic manner and its realization in a prototypical demonstra- tor for a mobile learning environment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a PLE concept for the mobile learner can be realized by the proposed symbiotic interrelation of mobile applications.
the symbiotic interrelation of mobile learning applications can enhance mobile learning environments and thus the mobile learning experience.
a symbiotic interrelation of services is essential to create an integrated mobile PLE.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the user is enabled to shape his mobile personalizable learning environment in the way he wants it to be.
the user can create his mobile personalizable learning environment in an easy and intuitive way.
the 2SIMPLE concept is a symbiotic interrelated seamless integrated mobile personalizable learning environment where the user is the center of the design.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a symbiotic interrelation of applications is not only a technical challenge but also a pedagogical one.
a mobile PLE should be seen as a collection of services that can be integrated into one another and that the user is in full control of the composition of his PLE.
the user can create a mobile PLE which is more than a simple aggregation of different applications but a symbiotic interrelated seamless integration of mobile services and features.
